info.title: Label_Switch
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

address_family.description: When service_type is l3-vpn, this field indicates the L3 service address family that is being carried.

counter_id.description: The counter id being allocated for packet counters which are  being received with MPLS label(s).

forwarding_state.description: The forwarding state for the Label_Switch entry.

in_label.description:
Reference Resource: [Label_Switch](#/Label_Switch)
Indicates the incoming label for the Label Switch Path.

internal_vlan_id.description: The internal vlan id being allocated for the service exit case.

l2_service.description:
Reference Resource: [VLAN](#/VLAN)
Reference to VLAN Table this service represents. This value is valid only when we have l2_service being carried. This value is applicable when the type is 'l2-vpn' service type.

l3_service.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
Reference to VRF Table this service represents. This value is valid only when we have l3_service being carried. This value is applicable when the type is 'l3-vpn' service type.

label_endpoint.description:
Reference Resource: [Label_Endpoint](#/Label_Endpoint)
Label_Endpoint entry that contains MPLS encapsulation informaiton in case of a Single path for this Label Switch entry. This will be valid in case of MPLS Transit cases only.

label_endpoint_applied.description:
Reference Resource: [Label_Endpoint](#/Label_Endpoint)
Set by the Data Plan to indicate the actual Label_Endpoint that the Data Plan configured for forwarding.

label_ingress_attributes.description: MPLS attributes that will be used in configuing the transit oe egress label bindings.

inherit_ttl.description: Indicates whether TTL value can be inherited from incomig label.

qos_mapping_table_id.description: The table ID used for obtatining the QoS re-map for transit or egress MPLS bindings.

use_qos_mapping_table.description: Indicates whether whether to use the QoS mapping table for this transit or exit MPLS bindings.

label_switch_index.description: The Label_Switch table entry in the asic.

label_switch_paths.description:
Reference Resource: [Label_Switch_Path](#/Label_Switch_Path)
List of Label_Switch_Path entries this Label_Switch references.

lsp_ecmp_group.description:
Reference Resource: [LSP_ECMP_Group](#/LSP_ECMP_Group)
ECMP Group entry that contains MPLS encapsulation information in case of multiple Label Switch Paths that can be used by this Label Switch entry. This will be valid in case of MPLS Transit cases only.

lsp_ecmp_group_applied.description:
Reference Resource: [LSP_ECMP_Group](#/LSP_ECMP_Group)
Set by the Data Plan to indicate the actual LSP_ECMP_Group that the Data Plan configured for forwarding.

port.description:
Reference Resource: [Label_Switch](#/Label_Switch)
Reference to the Port table, to which the Label switch entry belongs.

prefix.description: IPv4 destination prefix and mask in the address/mask format. Example 192.168.0.0/16 IPv6 destination prefix and mask in the address/mask format. Example 2001:0DB8:0000:000b::/64

service_label.description:
Reference Resource: [Label_Switch](#/Label_Switch)
Label value that the control plane has exchanged with its peer for carrying the service.

service_type.description: Type of Label Switch Path: 'l3-vpn'          : Indicates that the Label Switch Path carries l3-vpn service. 'l2-vpn'          : Indicates that the Label Switch Path carries l2-vpn service.

source.description: Indicates the source protocol for the Label Switch. LDP - Label Distribution Protocol BGP - Border Gateway Protocol static - Static LSP system - Built-in (system defined)

state.description: The state for the Label_Switch table entry.

mpls_pkt_rx.description: Number of packets received with MPLS label(s).

mpls_pkt_rx_octets.description: Number of octets/bytes received with MPLS label(s).

statistics_clear_performed.description: Number of times the statistics were cleared for  packets and octets/bytes received with MPLS label(s).

statistics_clear_requested.description: Number of times a request was made to clear statistics for  packets and octets/bytes received with MPLS label(s).

transit.description: If `true`, indicates a transit operation. If false,  indicates an exit operation.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
